answer_plain: Full mulch cover changes hydrogen uptake over two weeks by 50 % (range 11 to 92 %) by slowing evaporation, so uptake with mulch alone goes up in every case we tried, whereas full shade alone changes uptake by -25 % (range -28 to -1.7 %) and combining mulch with shade changes uptake by 14 % (range -6.2 to 70 %). Mulch keeps water in the sand without cooling the microbes, whereas shade cools the sand and slows enzyme speed.
answer_science: Central percentage change: h2_uptake_change_pct = 50.08 % (median 50.06 %, 50 % IQR [33.23, 66.16] %, joint 5–95 % interval [11.17, 91.82] %) (rounded headline: 50 %); absolute change h2_uptake_contrast_umol_m2 = 552 µmol m⁻² (median 399 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [153.4, 871.8] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [61.29, 1737] µmol m⁻²); absolute uptake h2_uptake_umol_m2 = 1654 µmol m⁻² (median 1420 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [525, 3347] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [209.5, 6167] µmol m⁻²) (mode = variance, refusal fraction = 0.0 %, max level refusal across question = 0.0 %). Top two Sobol' contributors to output variance: retention_b (ST = 0.59 [0.54, 0.65], S1 = 0.54) and psi_entry_mpa (ST = 0.25 [0.22, 0.28], S1 = 0.23). Status share of variance: verified_in_source ST = 0.00 (S1 = 0.00), modeller_assumption ST = 0.98 (S1 = 0.98), source_not_checked ST = 0.00 (S1 = 0.00) (joint group total indices can sum to more than 1 because of interactions). Limits: The parameter-uncertainty interval quantifies joint variation over literature constants and twin process parameters only and excludes external-model and twin model-structure error.

limits_plain: The range shows how much the answer moves when uncertain numbers in the models are varied; the models themselves could also be wrong. Organic mulch breakdown and extra carbon food for soil microbes are not included.
limits_science: The parameter-uncertainty interval quantifies joint variation over literature constants and twin process parameters only and excludes external-model and twin model-structure error. Treats mulch and shade as boundary forcing modifiers on evaporation and soil temperature only, excluding organic carbon leaching from mulch.
